title: Psychology of the Pixel
overview: Trading is 10% math and 90% character. Surrender your ego and learn to survive the emotional onslaught of the market.

modules.title: The FOMO Filter
modules.summary: Mastering the urge to revenge trade after a loss.

fixed_qna.a: It's an emotional response to a loss where a trader immediately increases size or takes excessive risk to 'make it back.' It is the fastest way to blow an account.

fixed_qna.q: How does Loss Aversion Bias affect my P&L?
fixed_qna.a: The pain of losing ₹1,000 is psychologically twice as powerful as the joy of winning ₹1,000. This causes traders to hold losing positions too long and sell winners too early.

modules.title: Red-Screen Survival
modules.summary: Maintaining tactical discipline during artificial market chaos.

fixed_qna.a: When the market enters high-volatility panic without a change in the underlying thesis. If your stop-loss isn't hit, the plan hasn't changed. Noise is not a signal.

title: Quant Technical Mastery
overview: Stop drawing lines and start understanding the calculus of momentum and volume.

modules.title: The Math Behind RSI
modules.summary: Calculated Relative Strength and internal momentum.

fixed_qna.a: RSI = 100 - [100 / (1 + RS)], where RS is the average gain of up periods divided by the average loss of down periods. It measures internal strength, not just price.

modules.title: Indicator Synergy
modules.summary: Eliminating redundancy in your strategy profile.

fixed_qna.q: Why is using three Moving Averages redundant?
fixed_qna.a: Because they all measure the same thing: Price Lag. A synergistic profile requires one trend indicator (MA), one momentum (RSI), and one volume (OBV).

title: Elite Chart Formations
overview: Master the geometry of market sentiment through professional chart patterns.

fixed_qna.q: What defines a 'Head and Shoulders' pattern?
fixed_qna.a: A high peak (head) flanked by two lower peaks (shoulders). The 'Neckline' connects the lows; a break below this line confirms a bearish reversal.

fixed_qna.q: How do I trade a Double Top?
fixed_qna.a: Wait for the price to fail at the same resistance twice. Only enter SHORT when the price breaks below the 'swing low' valley between the two peaks.

fixed_qna.q: What is the 'Pole' in a Bull Flag?
fixed_qna.a: The rapid, near-vertical price rise before the consolidation. The Flag is the brief pullback; the target is typically the length of the pole.

fixed_qna.q: What does a Bullish Engulfing candle signify?
fixed_qna.a: A large green candle that completely 'swallows' the previous small red candle. It indicates buyers have completely overwhelmed the sellers.

title: Market Survival & Mechanics
overview: Advanced execution: Stop-Loss, Short Selling, and Margin.

modules.title: Tactical Stop-Loss
modules.summary: How to protect your capital from total wipeout.

fixed_qna.q: Why is a Stop-Loss mandatory for Elite traders?
fixed_qna.a: It removes emotion from the exit. You decide your maximum loss BEFORE the heat of battle. Completing this unlocks the Stop-Loss feature in the trading terminal.

modules.title: Short Selling: Profit from Panic
modules.summary: Making money when a stock goes down.

fixed_qna.a: Borrowing shares to sell them at a high price, then buying them back cheaper later. It allows you to profit in Bear markets, but carries infinite theoretical risk.
